notes: Native Android app (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose + C++ NeonDsp). It has no web frontend, so nothing serves port 3000 and the preview iframe has nothing to render. The compose service 'android-toolchain' provides the JDK 17 + Android SDK 34 build environment; verify with `docker compose -f docker-compose.base44.yml exec android-toolchain ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug --no-daemon`.
